summary: This directory manages the static analysis and metadata extraction of Effect schema definitions. It provides logic to identify, validate, and decompose complex and primitive schema expressions into a structured format for further processing.
responsibilities: Verify whether a given initializer expression constitutes a valid Effect schema
Analyze and extract metadata from primitive schema types
Deconstruct non-primitive schema structures like Structs, Unions, and Arrays
relationships: The analysis process begins by checking if an initializer is a supported Effect schema type before performing full metadata extraction.
Primitive and non-primitive analysis routines are invoked based on the type classification of the schema expression.
Schema analysis relies on extracting metadata and underlying structural definitions to map complex types effectively.
designDecisions: Categorization of schema analysis logic based on primitive versus non-primitive type complexity
Encapsulation of schema identification logic separate from deep metadata extraction
